verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Issuing as a financial account feature: it can be rendered alongside Treasury in prebuilt embedded components, and Treasury and Issuing are launched together for platforms with shared risk controls. That suggests cards tied to the account, but only through glancing mentions. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of virtual and physical debit card issuance tied to the financial account via the same API, spend controls, digital wallet support, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
